mapper.sql: id, msg_id, destination, payload, delay_level, delay_ms, state, retry_count, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mq_outbox (msg_id, destination, payload, delay_level, delay_ms, state, retry_count, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{msgId}, #{destination}, #{payload}, #{delayLevel}, #{delayMs}, #{state}, #{retryCount}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM mq_outbox WHERE state = 0 AND update_time <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{timeoutSeconds} SECOND) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE mq_outbox SET state = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE msg_id = #{msgId} AND state = 0
